attributes.residual: NAMED MECHANISM. Target and ours are identical in all 53 instructions except a 9-word FPR renaming, and that renaming is only inconsistent because ONE pair of adjacent independent instructions is emitted in opposite order. At +0x3c the target computes fVar1 = (f32)p[0] (fsubs f5,f2,f4, consuming the lfd issued at +0x34) and at +0x40 computes fVar2 = (f32)p[2] - C (fsubs f6,f0,f1); ours emits those two exactly transposed. Both are ready at +0x3c, register ROLES already agree on both sides (f5=fVar1, f6=fVar2 in both), and the only knock-on is which registers the two loaded constants land in (target M=f4/C=f1, ours M=f3/C=f4). webfrank_audit rejects with 'use of f0 does not correspond to f2 under the running renaming' at exactly +0x3c. This is an MWCC list-scheduler tie-break between two ready, equal-priority FP subtractions and no tested source form reaches it.
